rules.name: Death Before Dishonour
rules.description: Every Japanese unit has the Fanatics special rule.

rules.name: Banzai Charge
rules.description: If a Japanese infantry unit is ordered to Run towards (or charge) the closest visible enemy, any order test for that move is automatically passed, as if the unit had rolled a double one. All models in the unit must then make a fulll move directly towards one of the models in the target unit, and must make contact with the target unit if possible. Note that a unit can be ordered to Run/charge in another direction, but in that case it will follow the normal rules and the Banzai Charge rule has no effect.

rules.name: Ambush Tactics
rules.description: During set-up, any Japanese unit starting the game Hidden may start the game already in Ambush. If you decide to do so, set one of your order dice in place next to them, as if you had ordered them to Ambush.

rules.name: Dual Weapons
rules.description: Rifle grenades can be fired in addition to the SMG or compression rifle.

rules.name: Raw Recruits
rules.description: Conscripts are not subject to the 'Death before Dishonour' national rule.

rules.name: One Man Turret
rules.description: It is always necessary to take an order test when issuing an Advance order, even if this unit is not pinned.

rules.name: Low-Velocity Light AT Gun
rules.description: This unit's Light AT Gun has a PEN value of +3 instead of the usual +4.

sharedRules.name: Show Your Loyalty!
sharedRules.description: If a Green friendly Japanese unit within 6" of the Kempeitai officer rolls for its Green special rule, the player may re-roll the result.

sharedRules.name: Phase Field
sharedRules.description: Models with Phase Field may ignore terrain when moving but not for line of sight. When using this ability to ignore terrain, roll a D6 for each model in the unit. If any of the D6 rolled comes up a 1, the unit is caught up in the terrain as some phasefields momentarily fail and the unit suffers a pin marker.
